summary: AXS summary views must preserve semantic firmware strings, zero-valued readings, and the latest known value of independently sampled fields.
reason: Dotted firmware versions cannot be JSON numbers, 0% battery is valid data, and summary records do not always carry every field; conflating their timestamps can erase a known firmware or voltage value.
validated_outcome: Firmware versions retain every segment, zero readings remain present, and newer partial summaries no longer erase known firmware or voltage values; regression tests plus Go test, vet, and build pass.
